newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 7.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Gao Jian, head of the finance ministry's state debt department, says standardisation is the pre-condition for the development of China's state debt market.

- Ma Kan, deputy head of the State Planning Commisssion, says the current inflation rate reflects the normal operations of the national economy, and the trend of blind investment and relaxation of money supply must be checked.

- Wang Yong, general manager of the newly-established national state debt central depository, stresses the need for all financial institutions to transfer their state debt positions to the central depository.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China is expected to attract $40 billion foreign investment in 1997.
- China's investment in real estate dropped a year-on-year 2.9 percent in the first five months of this year, the first time that property investment has fallen in the past few years.
